dog.description_text:
Hey there, I'm Rubbin, and I'm ready to steal your heart! At 6 months old, I'm a red and white bicolor mixed breed with a medium build, weighing about 20.3 pounds. I'm already neutered, and I have a medium energy level that makes me a great match for an active adventure buddy. The shelter describes me as adventurous, affectionate, cuddly, friendly, loyal, and playful, so come meet this little guy and see if we click! 🐾❤️ My adoption fee is $185.
This animal is located at our Westhampton Adoption Center, head in to meet them and see if you are a match! We are a same-day adoption center, and an application does not put you on a list or hold an animal for you. We are open Tuesday-Sunday 11am-4pm. Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped, and given their age appropriate shots. Apply for Adoption Today!
